name: Plain mermaid diagram, plain echarts option data, and an unrelated JS IIFE in its own (non-mermaid/echarts) fence
notes: TODOS #54 FP guard. A diagram/chart-rendering tool's ordinary output (declarative graph edges; a plain data-only echarts option object) must not match the fence+eval-idiom shape. Also proves the mermaid/echarts fence-type restriction is load-bearing: an entirely unrelated, completely benign JS code snippet using the classic (function(){...})() module pattern — extremely common in real code samples — sits in its own ```js fence in the SAME response text and must not be bridged into a false match just because a mermaid fence appears earlier in the same message.
